# The Indian Express

> > The Indian Express is India's leading English-language news platform covering national news, festivals, sports including IPL cricket, lifestyle, and trending content.

The Indian Express provides comprehensive coverage of Indian culture, festivals like Holi and Diwali, cricket tournaments including IPL standings, and trending global content. It serves as a trusted source for news, cultural information, and entertainment across India.

## Key Topics

- Holi festival dates and traditions
- Holika Dahan muhurat timings
- IPL cricket points table and standings
- Indian festivals and Hindu calendar
- Rangwali Holi and Dhulandi celebrations
- Lord Krishna and Radha traditions
- Festival of Colors celebrations
- Cricket rankings and playoff races
- Hindu festival observances
- Spring celebrations in India
- Drik Panchang calendar
- Indian cultural traditions
- YouTube trending content
